svg.text: All 24 EF Core tables · fields and key markers · field types omitted for legibility
PK = primary key · FK = database foreign key · nullable means the database column allows NULL.
* InventoryTransactions.UserId is a nullable shadow FK present in the EF model; it has no CLR property on InventoryTransaction.
CategoryId / UnitTypeId are not FK constraints. Original* IDs, ArchivedBy, RecordedBy, CreatedBy and ReferenceId are not FK constraints.
